proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Our cabin above Nederland has a gravel driveway that a big truck can't climb. They brought the small box truck, made two trips, and carried the couch the last fifty feet over the snow.
reviews.name: Leah V.

reviews.text: Moved my mom from her Table Mesa ranch to a one-bedroom in Louisville. They marked what would fit with blue tape after measuring her new rooms, and the rest went to donation the same week.
reviews.name: Grant F.

reviews.text: Mid-August, every street on the Hill had a truck on it. They parked around the corner, ran a dolly route down the alley and had my four roommates out by 11.
reviews.name: Sofia D.

reviews.text: We bought a house in Lafayette with a basement full of the last owner's furniture. One load to the reuse store, one to the dump, and the floor was swept when they left.
reviews.name: Nate C.

reviews.text: Gun safe up three steps into a Longmont split-level. Four of them, a stair roller and a lot of counting out loud. The new carpet on the landing came through fine.
reviews.name: Rob E.

reviews.text: They packed our kitchen in about three hours and wrote what was in each box on two sides, which sounds small until you're looking for the kettle at 7 a.m. in Erie.
reviews.name: Mei S.

proof.guarantee: Anything we pack or wrap that arrives damaged, we repair or pay to repair.
